question:
In the adjoining figure line l is parallel to line m. What is the value of (x + 2y) ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/905c2a270ecc9e29bc4cc0942201541f2d5e6ffded406685ccf504d4f877d95c.png]
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Identify that **line l** and **line m** are **parallel**, making **x** and **y** co-interior angles.

The sum of **co-interior angles** is always **180°**, so **x + y = 180°**.

The expression **(x + 2y)** can be rewritten as **(x + y) + y**.

From the geometric figure, the obtuse angle **y** is **135°**, which means **x = 45°**.

⇒ **(x + 2y) = 180° + 135° = 315°**.

**∴ The correct answer is 315°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ Line **l || m**.

⇒ Angle **x** and angle **y** are **interior angles** on the same side of the **transversal**.

**Formula Used:**

⇒ Sum of **co-interior angles** = **180°**.

⇒ **Linear Pair** property: Sum of angles on a straight line = **180°**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb6df9dee73600e7e976b5de82ac218cd1bc9d20a3a619d5ebb5302638e9bf98.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Since **l || m**, the **co-interior angles** **x** and **y** satisfy the condition: **x + y = 180°**.

⇒ From the given figure, the value of the **obtuse angle** **y** is observed to be **135°**.

⇒ To find **x**: **x = 180° − 135° = 45°**.

⇒ Now, calculate the required value: **(x + 2y)**.

⇒ **(x + 2y) = 45° + 2(135°)**.

⇒ **(x + 2y) = 45° + 270°**.

⇒ **(x + 2y) = 315°**.

**∴ The correct answer is 315°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Corresponding Angles

When two parallel lines are cut by a transversal, the angles in matching corners are equal.

Alternate Interior Angles

Angles between parallel lines on opposite sides of a transversal are equal (Z-pattern).

Consecutive Interior Angles

Also known as co-interior angles, these are located between the parallel lines on the same side and sum to 180°.</p
